text: What'll it be, love?
Pull up a stool. Mind the one with three legs.
Evening, {player}. Usual?
Oh no. It's you. I'm watering the champion's rum tonight.
Sit in the back, will you? There's a Tidewatch man at the bar.
Happy {festival}, {player}! Everyone's in good spirits.
It's the {festival}. Half the town's drunk and the other half's working on it.
Times are hard here. The town's {town_mood}.
Trade's dried up. If you've cargo to sell, sell it here; we need it.
Town's {town_mood}! Coin everywhere you look.
Never seen the harbour so busy.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Happy {festival}, {player}! Everyone's in good spirits.
It's the {festival}. Half the town's drunk and the other half's working on it.

options.label: I challenge the house to a drinking contest! (2 doubloons)
Who's looking for a crew? (the Lookout)

text: The table's cleared, the tankards are full.
There's always a parcel needs carrying. Folk trust a sealed parcel with a pirate more than you'd think.
Get it there on time and you'll be paid in full. Late, and they'll grumble and pay half.
The cards are dealt.
Another hand?
The Lookout board's by the door. Sign up for the tournament, the range, the guns or a privateer war, and when enough of you are keen, off you all go together.
Type /lookout to see who's waiting.
